text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 91-93 पर मयंक की चिट्ठी पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 91-93 par Mayank ki chitthi padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read Mayank's letter on pages 91–93 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Where does Mayank live?
steps.modelAnswer: Mayank lives in a small village, Kevadeshwar, in Indore district.

modelMeaning.hi: मयंक इंदौर ज़िले के एक छोटे गाँव केवडेश्वर में रहता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mayank Indore zile ke ek chhote gaanv Kevadeshwar mein rehta hai.

steps.question: Who wrote a letter to Priya and why?

questionMeaning.hi: प्रिया को चिट्ठी किसने और क्यों लिखी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Priya ko chitthi kisne aur kyon likhi?

options: Mayank, to tell her about the water conservation programme
steps.answer: Mayank, to tell her about the water conservation programme
steps.modelAnswer: Mayank wrote the letter to Priya in reply to her letter, to tell her about the water conservation programme in his village.

modelMeaning.hi: मयंक ने प्रिया की चिट्ठी के जवाब में उसे गाँव के जल संरक्षण कार्यक्रम के बारे में बताने के लिए लिखी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mayank ne Priya ki chitthi ke jawab mein use gaanv ke jal sanrakshan kaaryakram ke baare mein bataane ke liye likhi.

steps.question: What programme was launched in the village?

questionMeaning.hi: गाँव में कौन सा कार्यक्रम शुरू हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gaanv mein kaun sa kaaryakram shuru hua?

steps.question: What is meant by the word ‘conservation’?
options: to save something, like water, energy or soil
steps.answer: to save something, like water, energy or soil
steps.modelAnswer: Conservation literally means to save something. It may be water, energy, soil or some species of animals and plants.

modelMeaning.hi: संरक्षण का मतलब है किसी चीज़ को बचाना, जैसे पानी, ऊर्जा, मिट्टी या जीव-जंतु और पौधे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Sanrakshan ka matlab hai kisi cheez ko bachaana, jaise paani, oorja, mitti ya jeev-jantu aur paudhe.

steps.question: Why do the villagers migrate to cities and towns?

questionMeaning.hi: गाँव वाले शहर क्यों जाते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gaanv waale shahar kyon jaate hain?

options: Without water, crops fail, so they go in search of work.
steps.answer: Without water, crops fail, so they go in search of work.
steps.modelAnswer: When there is no water, crops fail and there is a shortage of food. So the villagers migrate to cities and towns in search of work.

modelMeaning.hi: पानी न होने से फ़सलें ख़राब होती हैं और अनाज की कमी होती है, इसलिए गाँव वाले काम की तलाश में शहर जाते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Paani na hone se fasalein kharaab hoti hain aur anaaj ki kami hoti hai, isliye gaanv waale kaam ki talaash mein shahar jaate hain.

steps.question: What are we trying to do under the water conservation programme?

questionMeaning.hi: जल संरक्षण कार्यक्रम में क्या कर रहे हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jal sanrakshan kaaryakram mein kya kar rahe hain?

options: harvest rainwater with bunds, ponds, wells and stop dams
steps.answer: harvest rainwater with bunds, ponds, wells and stop dams
steps.modelAnswer: We are trying to harvest rainwater: farmers build Medha Bandh and small ponds in fields, old wells and ponds are deepened and cleaned, and stop dams are repaired.

modelMeaning.hi: हम बारिश का पानी जमा कर रहे हैं: किसान खेतों में मेढ़ बंध और छोटे तालाब बना रहे हैं, पुराने कुएँ-तालाब गहरे और साफ़ हो रहे हैं, और स्टॉप डैम ठीक हो रहे हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Hum baarish ka paani jama kar rahe hain: kisaan kheton mein medh bandh aur chhote taalaab bana rahe hain, puraane kuen-taalaab gehre aur saaf ho rahe hain, aur stop dam theek ho rahe hain.

steps.question: A dam is ...
options: a big wall across a river
steps.answer: a big wall across a river

steps.question: A ‘slogan’ means ...
options: words giving a message attractively and quickly
steps.answer: words giving a message attractively and quickly
